scope: Independent bounded regression probes for product exclusion polarity and non-product -specific adjectives after PR 33, plus small preservation and exploratory probes. This is not a broad semantic retrieval benchmark.

evaluationProtocol.forbiddenProducts: No matching excluded-product identity is allowed anywhere in the returned Meili provider results. Empty output satisfies exclusion-only checks but is not evidence of useful retrieval.
evaluationProtocol.positiveRetention: A core named-product target must appear within the top five provider results; no claim is made about exact rank.
evaluationProtocol.genericPairCheck: Compare each variant with its control on the same candidate. The variant must preserve a relevant result when the control has one, and relevant-at-5 must not decrease. Report baseline and candidate counts, including controls; do not hide a weak control behind a passing relative comparison.
evaluationProtocol.unknownSpecific: An unrecognized explicit specific-product request must abstain rather than return unrelated known-product results.
evaluationProtocol.exploratoryNearSpelling: Either abstention or the intended known product is acceptable as exploratory behavior; unrelated products are recorded as unsafe drift. This probe alone does not require typo correction and is not a release gate.
requiredCaptureProvenance: clean/dirty status and dirty patch digest if applicable
raw returned IDs and scores if supplied
evaluationProtocol.releaseGate: Pass core gates and preservation smoke checks or explicitly disclose unaddressed limits. Any revision made after unblinding is reported as a tuned revision, not as the original frozen candidate.
